Minanti.g: nāḷiyādīsu dhaññaṁ viya anto pakkhipanti, na bahi karontīti attho.

mine.g: samma Kāḷahatthi yo kusaggeneva udakaṁ gahetvā “ettakaṁ siyā mahāsamudde udakan”ti tena saddhiṁ upamāya mineyya, so kevalaṁ mineyyeva, kusagge pana udakaṁ atiparittakameva.
